title: Validation Entity
description: JSON Schema for Validation entity in customer workspace. Validations are rules that assert data quality and reject invalid events within a workflow flow. Each validation references its workflow via workflow_id and the upstream entity it applies to via upstream_entity_id.

upstream_entity_id.description: Reference to the upstream entity this validation applies to (connection, transformation, validation, or data product)

upstream_entity_type.description: Entity type of the upstream entity

schema_id.description: Org domain schema reference; deploy resolves latest active version into rules.schema when rules.schema is empty

schema_version_id.description: Pinned org domain schema version; deploy resolves definition into rules.schema when rules.schema is empty

rules.description: Validation rules (structure depends on validation_type). For validation_type schema, rules.schema holds the JSON Schema; rules.schema_id may reference org registry instead.

error_message.description: Custom error message when validation fails

order.description: Default execution order when used in workflows (lower = earlier)

batch_size.description: Runtime tuning: events per handler call (rstreams offload batch). Does not cap events read per run; that is bounded by the Lambda timeout and memory thresholds. Unset: 300. Out-of-range values fail deploy.

runtime_memory_mb.description: Runtime tuning: shared runtimes Lambda memory tier (connectors-{mb}). Unset: 256. Any other value fails deploy.

created_by.description: User ID who created the validation

updated_by.description: User ID who last updated the validation

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when validation was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when validation was last updated

deleted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when validation was deleted (soft delete)

output_queue_display_name.description: Observe label for this validation's output queue. Deploy writes it onto the existing queue id and leaves bindings, checkpoints, and bot pause unchanged. Unset: the generated label stays the fallback and is not overwritten.

error_queue_display_name.description: Observe label for this validation's error queue. Deploy writes it onto the existing queue id and leaves bindings, checkpoints, and bot pause unchanged. Unset: the generated label stays the fallback and is not overwritten.
